Nina R.: SI flagged an install blocker: customer cluster disallows direct egress except via a corporate proxy with dynamic NAT. Our helm job failing on image pulls.
Carlos V.: can you paste the error from the installer?
Nina R.: SI log: 
``
Error: failed to pull image \"registry.redwood.ai/marketplace/agent:2.0.1\" - Get \"https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/\": proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 10.20.30.5:3128: connect: network is unreachable
```
Anika B.: common for highly locked down infra. Options: signed offline bundle + local mirror import, temporary whitelisting of our registry IPs, or a transient image-prefetch job that runs from a node that has outbound.
Theo J.: customer is SOC-heavy and won't do whitelisting. They asked for a checklist to import a signed bundle into their air-gapped mirror.
Carlos V.: we have an offline-artifact flow. Link: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/offline-bundles/marketplace/v2.0.1-signed.tar.gz
Nina R.: SI wants a short, non-technical checklist for their infra team and a verification step to satisfy SOC (checksum + signature verification).
Anika B.: draft checklist: 1) download tarball, 2) verify sha256 and GPG signature, 3) extract and run `podman load` or `ctr image import`, 4) push to local registry, 5) update Helm values to point at local registry and apply imagePullSecrets. Add example commands.
Theo J.: also include an integrity proof they can present to SOC: include signed manifest.json and verification steps with gpg --verify.
infra-bot: note: marketplace-install job failed (customer-id: cx-92) -- automation ticket created #INF-5214
Carlos V.: SI asked if we can supply a tiny prefetch Job manifest in case the mirror import path stalls. We should label it \"advanced fallback\" and document the security implications.
Nina R.: agree. Keep the prefetch non-privileged if possible. Provide both privileged and non-privileged variants.
Anika B.: I'll prepare: 1) mirror-import checklist with commands, 2) signed manifest + GPG keys, 3) prefetch Job manifests (privileged and podman-based non-priv).
Theo J.: add a runbook note: \"If cluster uses dynamic proxy/NAT, prefer mirror import; prefetch is allowed only with SOC approval and a timeboxed window.\"
Carlos V.: SI will try the mirror import and will reach back within 4 hours. If they need help, we offer a short remote session to walk infra team through the import.
Nina R.: thanks all. Adding these artifacts to the partner-runbook and attaching SOC checklist template. Closing until SI updates. :wave:
